import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { InPageSection } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class InPageNavigation extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        sections: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        activeId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        narrowMode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        expanded: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    sections: readonly InPageSection[];
    activeId: string | undefined;
    narrowMode: string;
    private expanded;
    private observed?;
    private localActive;
    private observedKey;
    private initialObservation;
    private activationTarget;
    private mutation?;
    private observedTargets;
    constructor();
    private flat;
    updated(): void;
    private trackScroll;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private activate;
    private list;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
